description:
Advances: specled.tagged_tests, specled.verification

Follow-up from specled_-epl cold review (verifier Notes 1/2 + elixir-test-critic ADVISORY-1; all advisory, no blocking findings — implementation is complete, this is test-coverage hardening only).

Two uncovered cells in the specled_-epl diff (commit e28ee6d):

1. specled.tagged_tests.findings_echo_exunit_seed enumerates failed/timeout x attributed/shared-fate; tests cover 3 of 4 cells. The shared-fate TIMEOUT path (command_timeout_details/1, lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex ~634-638 — timeout with NO attribution artifact) has no direct seed-echo assertion. Fix: in test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs, add a test mirroring 'a timeout finding echoes the ExUnit seed' (~:1589) whose shim echoes 'Running ExUnit with seed: 424242, max_cases: 8' then sleeps past the 2000ms budget WITHOUT writing $SPECLED_ATTRIBUTION_PATH; assert both verification_command_timeout findings contain '--seed 424242'.

2. specled.verify.command_output_capture_dir guard is 'result.timed_out or result.exit_code != 0'; only the exit-code branch is asserted (capture test asserts timed_out: false). Fix: assert a timed-out command's capture file records 'timed_out: true' (can ride the same new test by also setting SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR, or use a generic command-kind slow target with a short --command-timeout-ms).

Optional (critic ADVISORY-2/3): split the bundled pass/unwritable capture test into two; align the three seed tests on minimal contract tokens (seed number + '--seed 424242') instead of connective prose.

Both paths route through the same helpers as tested cells (exunit_seed_note/1, preserve_failed_output/2), so risk is low — do not treat as a bug.

comments.text:
Consolidated critical-review Tier-2 items for specled_-epl (report: ~/vaults/rmbrs-vault/code_review/critical/specled_ex/2026-07-24/specled_-epl-flake-capture/20260724-081329-consolidated.md, review_commit e28ee6d, Tier 1 empty — 0C/0H/4M/9L). Adding these to this ticket's scope alongside the original coverage gaps:

1. F9 (spec drift, M): specled.tagged_tests.findings_echo_exunit_seed scopes the seed echo to "a merged tagged_tests run", but exunit_seed_note/1 also fires for generic kind:command verification failures/timeouts (verifier.ex:630,636,651). Either scope the requirement up (owning subject specled.verification gains a covering requirement) or scope the code down. Code-broader-than-spec.

2. CF1 (consensus spec+testing, M): resume-pass timeout findings pair the FIRST run's seed (resumed_result/4 keeps first_result.output, verifier.ex:2212-2220) with the RESUME run's hang suspects (verifier.ex:504). Reviewers disagree whether first-run seed is the right choice or misleading — decide, spec it explicitly for the multi-run case, and pin it with a test (the original-seed guard is the single highest-value test per the testing reviewer).

3. F4 (idioms, M): preserve_failed_output/2's bare `rescue _ -> :ok` (verifier.ex:2360-2380) makes forensic capture fail silently on exactly the loaded runner it exists to diagnose. Narrow the rescue (File.Error) and emit a one-line warning on capture failure.

4. F10 (testing, M): the requirement's negative half — "no seed line ⇒ findings unchanged" — has no assertion; a spurious appended line would pass every existing =~ check. Add the negative test.

Cross-cutting theme worth honoring in the fix: all of F9/CF1/F10 point at one imprecise contract (the seed-echo requirement), so fix the requirement text once and let the tests follow.

IMPLEMENTED

Commit: 228a3d1 (branch specled_-viv/seed-echo-coverage, based on specled_-hyt d68b523 which sits on origin/main 4a374be)
Files touched: lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex, test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs, .spec/specs/verification.spec.md, .spec/specs/tagged_tests_verification.spec.md
Tests added: SpecLedEx.VerifierTest "a shared-fate timeout finding echoes the ExUnit seed and its capture records timed_out" (cells 1+2), "a failure without a seed line appends no seed note" (F10), "a double timeout pairs each seed with its run: first-run seed primary, resume seed in the suffix" (CF1 pin), "a generic command failure echoes the seed and a seedless failure appends no note" (F9 coverage); extended "passing commands write no capture and an unwritable dir leaves the result unchanged" to assert the new stderr warning (F4)
Verification stubs flipped: none — specled.verify.command_findings_echo_exunit_seed added to the existing execute:true tagged_tests covers block in verification.spec.md; tagged_tests requirement rides its existing entry
Verification tier: change-scoped — verifier_test.exs (52 tests, 0 failures), mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix format --check-formatted, mix spec.check --no-run-commands (status=pass errors=0 warnings=0); full-system proof deferred to the merge gate / PR CI
Final-tier runs: 2 (finals_gt1: first spec-gate run surfaced overlap/duplicate_covers — one scenario per requirement id — so the new scenarios were folded into the existing findings_echo_seed and command_output_capture_dir scenarios; tests were green on both runs)

CF1 decision recorded in spec: the finding's primary seed echo is the FIRST run's seed (the retained output belongs to the first run); when the resume pass also timed out and drew its own seed, the resume-timeout suffix names that resume seed next to the resume run's hang suspects, so each seed is paired with the run it reproduces. F9 resolved by scoping UP: new specled.verify.command_findings_echo_exunit_seed on specled.verification covers generic command kinds; the tagged_tests requirement pins merged-run distribution and multi-run pairing and cross-references it.

Deliberately skipped (explicitly optional in ticket, not omitted musts): critic ADVISORY-2 (split the bundled pass/unwritable capture test) and ADVISORY-3 (align the three pre-existing seed tests on minimal contract tokens).

Summary: Adds the two missing coverage cells (shared-fate timeout seed echo; timed_out: true capture assertion) and resolves all four consolidated Tier-2 items by tightening the seed-echo contract once — requirement scope-up to specled.verification, explicit multi-run seed pairing carried by resumed_result/4's new :resume_seed and resume_seed_note/1, a narrowed File.Error rescue with a one-line stderr warning in preserve_failed_output/2, and direct negative assertions.
